description: First-wave Knowledge compatibility record and the neutral technical data leaf's locks. P0b froze the first revision at 0da7e2f960cd4ec994ae8eddea5b71023c5379ca, K01 re-recorded every leaf hash before the code move, K02 changed only the data leaf's locked file hash, and C2 (#451) moved that leaf byte for byte to inferrsi.resources.repository_packs. The R1 revision (#412) deleted the seven root Knowledge shells with their eight pairs, so compatibility_pairs is empty and the allowlist blocker is gone. The former ninth pair, infra.inspection -> the data leaf, is now the permanent exact rule (its importer moved to apps.host.inspection in #498 slice 3a) in technical_leaf.permanent_importers, outside the allowlist. The nine retired pair records, with the old root leaf hashes and export lists, are kept unchanged under the C2 revision_history entry, the record that R1 appended; it is no longer the last entry. The leaf's bytes and locked file hash are unchanged. Nothing here is a wildcard approval, and it changes only through formal review. Line references are at the base_commit recorded by the revision that wrote them; no later revision re-records them. This A1 revision (#408) removes technical_leaf.temporary_importers with root arguments.py: the moved Apps parser reads the same REPO_TYPES object through inferrsi.knowledge.catalog, no Apps importer of the leaf is declared, and the removed entry is kept unchanged as retired_temporary_importers under the last revision_history entry, the R1 record.

The file bytes are unchanged, so the locked file hash keeps its value. The leaf's module and file, the neutral_leaf_export target and the targets of the catalog and infra.inspection pairs change to the new module. The seven root leaf hashes and the nine-pair count are unchanged.

The technical leaf's module, file, bytes, locked hash, allowed imports, two symbols, top-level shape and import-free parent initializer are unchanged.

current_fragment.source:
# Neutral raw repository-pack data leaf (D020). It holds only the original
# REPO_TYPES tuple and pack.json reader, and imports no inferrsi module.
# K02 moved pack.json to the Harness resource root (D007). The anchor stays the
# root package and joins the physical path, so reading a Harness-owned resource
# never imports inferrsi.harness and never gives infra an edge into Harness.
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from importlib.resources import files
from typing import Any

REPO_TYPES = (
    "vllm", "vllm_omni", "vllm_musa", "afd_plugin", "vllm_rlt", "strata", "sglang", "sglang_omni"
)


def repository_pack(repo_type: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if repo_type not in REPO_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown repository type: {repo_type}")
    path = files("inferrsi").joinpath("harness", "data", "repo_packs", repo_type, "pack.json")
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
